# mergeah_connector_tool_description_overrides (Data Source)

Read Merge Agent Handler connector_tool_description_overrides. Results are available as JSON via response_json; paginated collections are fetched completely.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure the provider as shown in examples/provider/provider.tf.
data "mergeah_connector_tool_description_overrides" "example" {
}

locals {
  connector_tool_description_overrides = jsondecode(data.mergeah_connector_tool_description_overrides.example.response_json)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `connector_slug` (String) Filter by connector slug. Sent to the API as the `slug` query parameter.
- `query` (Map of String) Additional documented API query parameters. All pages are fetched automatically. Values must be strings.

### Read-Only

- `response_json` (String, Sensitive) JSON object for a detail endpoint, or JSON array containing every item for a collection. Use jsondecode to read fields. Sensitive because API records may contain personal data.
